title: Faung Cheng Chia - Chinese Lawyer

page_data.en:
(C.I.D.) Office Notes

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 1103.
Date..24..- 3.- 30.
March 22, 1930.

Faung Cheng Chia 方振甲 Chinese lawyer.

This lawyer Faung Cheng Chia 方振甲 is a native of Anwhui
about 30 years old.
He is a graduate of a Japanese law school in Tokio.
He arrived in Shanghai sometime in December 1929
and became a member of the Shanghai Bar Association
in February 1930, after which he opened an office .
at No.5 Ss Sz Faung 西西坊 off Rue Brenier de Montmorand
French Concession which is also his dwelling house.
Prior to his arrival in Shanghai he practised law
in Tientsin and Peking but with little success.
He is little known amongst his colleagues here
and is not much thought of.
So far as I can ascertain he has little to do
with politics.

Jas. Harding
Clerical Assistant.

Actg D.C.I.

A.B.S.I.
The inquiries re Faung were
made at the request of Mr Justice Feetham
to whom a copy of this report
has been sent.
YK
24/3/30.
page_data.zh:
（刑事调查处）办公室笔记

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事调查处档案室
编号：I. O. D. 1103。
日期..24..- 3.- 30。
1930年3月22日。

方振甲，中国律师。

该律师方振甲系安徽人，
约30岁。
他毕业于东京的一所日本法律学校。
他于1929年12月间抵达上海，
并于1930年2月成为上海律师公会会员，随后在
法租界蒙马兰路（Rue Brenier de Montmorand）旁的西西坊5号开设事务所，
此处亦为其寓所。
在抵沪之前，他曾在天津和北京执业，
但成效甚微。
他在本地的同行中鲜为人知，
且不受重视。
据我所查，他与政治
几乎没有什么关联。

Jas. Harding
文书助理。

代理副督察长

A.B.S.I.
关于方振甲的调查
是应费唐法官（Mr Justice Feetham）的要求进行的，
本报告副本
已送交给他。
YK
1930年3月24日。
